basic_profile.bio: An avid gamer based in Pittsburgh, PA, who has been part of the Reddit community for over 7 years. I'm a software developer by day, specializing in game development, and a passionate gamer by night. I have a keen interest in strategy games and often spend my evenings diving into the mechanics of games like Shadow Fight Arena. I live with my partner and our two cats. Typically active on Reddit during evenings and weekends, I enjoy engaging in discussions about game strategies and bug fixes. Outside of gaming, I'm a violin enthusiast and spend weekends learning new pieces.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science from Carnegie Mellon University and over a decade of experience in game development. My expertise in software development is mostly self-taught, honed through countless hours of coding and problem-solving in the gaming industry. My interest in gaming strategies often finds me experimenting with game mechanics to understand their underlying algorithms.
